g.text: Planar simulation, Falcon 9-class vehicle (stage 1: 25.6 t dry, 395.7 t propellant, 7.6–8.2 MN, Isp 283–312 s; stage 2: 3.9 t dry, 92.7 t, 981 kN, 348 s; fairing 1.9 t),
19.1 t payload to a 200 km circular orbit from 28.5° N with 22 t of first-stage propellant kept for a droneship landing; US 1976 atmosphere, rotating Earth, 4.5 g limit.
